translations.albanian: E vjetrofsh dhe Allahu i Lartmadhëruar ta zëvendësoftë me tjetrën.
translations.english: (May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it (with another).’ The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.)
translations.indonesian: Silsilah Ahadits As-Shahihah (11 Jilid); Syaikh Muhammad Nashiruddin Al-Albani rahimahullah. Penerbit: Maktabah Al-Ma'arif Linnasyir Wa At-Tauji', Riyadl-KSA.
